items.headline: Johnson and Smith Join DP World Tour
items.text: Dustin Johnson and Cameron Smith accepted special-status agreements with the DP World Tour for 2027, securing invitations to select events after LIV Golf's collapse.

items.headline: Tiger Woods to Return at Hero World Challenge
items.text: Tiger Woods will make his competitive return Dec. 3-6 at the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas, his first event since the 2024 Open Championship.
